# Why Was My Bankruptcy Dismissed? - Common Reasons [2026]
> Last updated: 2026-09-25

> Why was your bankruptcy dismissed? Missed payments, incomplete forms, bad faith, and means test failure. How to fix it and refile.

## About
whywasmybankruptcydismissed.com is part of the Open Bankruptcy Project (openbankruptcyproject.org), a 501(c)(3) nonprofit building free, open-source tools for bankruptcy court transparency.
